name: Face ID / Touch ID lock
description: Locks sensitive content behind Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode with LocalAuthentication, re-locking when the app goes to the background.

infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID keeps your information private.

usage: Wrap a screen with `.biometricLock(isEnabled: settings.lockEnabled)`; it shows `LockedView` until the user authenticates and locks again when the scene leaves the foreground. Inject `any BiometricAuthenticating` for tests (`PreviewBiometricAuthenticator`). This protects content on the device; it is not account sign-in. Rewrite `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` for the app.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify biometric-unlock` on a Mac with Xcode.
